{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Outskirt Stable}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} and the '''Pure-White Horses''',{{Cite|A traveler... Tell me, have you seen a {{Color BotW|Red|pure-white horse}} anywhere? A long time back, my grandfather told me that he once saw the royal family's {{Color BotW|Red|white horse}} grazing on {{Color BotW|Blue|Safula Hill}}... The thing is...just the other day, one of our customers said he saw a {{Color BotW|Red|white horse}} on {{Color BotW|Blue|Safula Hill}} recently... Could it be a relative of the royal family's {{Color BotW|Red|white horse}} from my grandfather's day? Well, if you happen to see a {{Color BotW|Red|white horse}} on your travels, do you think you could bring it back to me?|Toffa|BotW}} are recurring [[Creature]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Characteristics== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract|White Horse}} White Horses are a special breed of [[Horse]]s that possess pure-white coats with no mottling.{{Cite|The {{Color BotW|Red|white horse}} on {{Color BotW|Blue|Safula Hill}} supposedly has a beautiful pure-white coat without any mottling... They say it roams by itself, apart from other groups of horses. If you end up finding it and {{Color BotW|Blue|registering it}} at a stable, I'd really love to see it. Thanks.|Toffa|BotW}} They were ridden by the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]] prior to the second [[Great Calamity]] to demonstrate their divine right.{{Cite|The Hyrulean royal family that perished 100 years ago would sometimes ride atop white horses as a display of their divine right. This white horse may be a descendant of one once ridden by royalty.|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}} At least two White Horses are known to exist in {{BotW}}. The first White Horse was owned by [[Princess Zelda|Zelda]] before to the second Great Calamity. In addition to the [[Royal Horse Gear]], which consists of the [[Royal Bridle]] and [[Royal Saddle]], Zelda's original White Horse had a [[French-Braided Mane]]. During the "[[Champion Revali's Song (Memory)|Champion Revali's Song]]" [[EX Recovered Memory]], Zelda can be seen riding her White Horse to the [[Flight Range]]. Next, her White Horse is seen in the "[[Zelda's Resentment]]" [[Recovered Memory]], where Zelda is shown to have ridden him to [[Tena Ko'sah Shrine]] at the [[Ancient Columns]]. In the "[[To Mount Lanayru]]" Recovered Memory, Zelda mentions that [[Link]] counseled her on how to soothe her Horse.{{Cite|"Be sure to take the time to soothe your mount... That's the only way it will know how you truly feel." Your advice was quite helpful—thank you. This little one and I are getting along quite well now.|Zelda|BotW}} Heeding his advice, Zelda equipped her White Horse with the Royal Horse Gear. Together, she and Link ride their Horses to [[Sanidin Park Ruins|Sanidin Park]]. While Zelda was visiting the Park, [[Toffa]]'s grandfather saw her atop her White Horse, which is a moment he remembered as indescribably beautiful.{{Cite|The {{Color BotW|Red|white horse}} that {{Color BotW|Blue|Princess Zelda}} rode. The one my grandfather told me about when I was little... The sight of the princess riding atop the {{Color BotW|Red|white horse}} was supposed to be a beauty beyond words... There's no doubt about it, this {{Color BotW|Red|horse}} is the grandchild of that horse of long ago. So beautiful... So pure...|Toffa|BotW}} Following the Great Calamity, Toffa's grandfather came into possession of the Royal Bridle and Royal Saddle, which he passed on to his grandson alongside tales of the White Horse. The second White Horse is speculated to be a grandchild of the one owned by Zelda. Following Link's [[Slumber of Restoration]], a traveler spotted the White Horse isolated atop [[Safula Hill]], and word of it eventually reached Toffa at the [[Outskirt Stable]]. Wishing to see the White Horse for himself, Toffa asks Link to tame the Horse and return to him after registering it at a [[Stable]], beginning "[[The Royal White Stallion]]" [[Side Quest]]. If Link tames the White Horse and speaks to Toffa before registering it, Toffa will prompt him to register it and return immediately.{{Cite|Oh! You— That {{Color BotW|Red|white horse}}! You can {{Color BotW|Blue|register that beauty}} at this stable's reception desk. Go {{Color BotW|Blue|register}} the {{Color BotW|Red|white horse}} and then come right back!|Toffa|BotW}}{{Cite|You can {{Color BotW|Blue|register your horse}} here at the stable's reception desk! Talk to me again after you've {{Color BotW|Blue|registered}} your {{Color BotW|Red|white horse}}!|Toffa|BotW}} Upon successfully showing Toffa the White Horse after registering it, he will give Link the Royal Horse Gear as a reward.{{Cite|What? You brought the royal family's {{Color BotW|Red|white horse}}? Well I'll be... Grandpa wasn't lying! Son, you just made my life. Staying alive in this godforsaken land may just have been worth it after all. I've got a surprise for you. My grandpa handed this down to me, and now I'm handing it down to you. I present to you...the royal family's saddle and bridle! Custom fitted for the white royal horse!|Toffa|BotW}} The Royal Bridle and Royal Saddle are immediately equipped to the White Horse, regardless of Link's Bond with it. This completes the Side Quest. After completing the Quest, Toffa will inform Link of his fantasy of riding the White Horse with a woman like Zelda.{{Cite|If I was a bit younger, I would go off on an adventure. I'd ride the {{Color BotW|Red|white horse}} with a gal just like the {{Color BotW|Blue|princess}}!|Toffa|BotW}} If the White Horse perishes before Link can register it at a Stable, it will reappear on Safula Hill the following day. Once registered, the White Horse will no longer reappear on Safula Hill unless it is released. If it is killed, it can only be brought back by [[Malanya]] at his [[Malanya Spring|Spring]]. During the special cutscene that plays after Link completes both the "[[Captured Memories]]" and "[[Destroy Ganon]]" [[Main Quest]]s, Zelda has a White Horse with her. She makes plans to ride her White Horse to [[Zora's Domain]] to investigate the source of [[Divine Beast Vah Ruta]]'s malfunction, in addition to bringing closure to [[King Dorephan]] over his late daughter, [[Mipha]].{{Cite|We'll make our way to Zora's Domain. Divine Beast Vah Ruta...looks like it stopped working. Let's investigate the situation. Mipha's father... I believe he would like to hear more about her. The least we can do is visit him and offer him some closure.|Zelda|BotW}} According to [[Baddek]], girls often talk dreamily about princes on White Horses, though he would prefer to have the White Horse.{{Cite|Girls often talk dreamily about princes on white horses or some odd nonsense... But I couldn't care less about some stuffy prince. Give me the white horse! Pinto, chestnut, black... Horse coats come in many different colors, but white horses take my breath away.|Baddek|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|White Horse}} The White Horse can be found among a herd of other [[Horse]]s in the [[Akkala Wilds]] north of [[Skull Lake]]. Alternatively, if Link had the White Horse registered in {{BotW|-}}, its save data will be carried over to {{TotK|-}}. ==Trivia== *In {{OoT}}, [[Impa]] and [[Princess Zelda]] ride upon a white horse when they flee from [[Ganondorf]] after his attack on [[Hyrule Castle]]. Presumably, the White Horses that appear in {{BotW|-}} are a reference to the white horse from {{OoT|-}} given their association with incarnations of Princess Zelda and the [[Royal Family of Hyrule]]. * The White Horse, the [[Giant Horse]], the [[Lord of the Mountain]], and [[Patricia]] are the only individuals to get their own unique entries in the [[Hyrule Compendium]] separate from the rest of their species. * The White Horse is one of nine rideable [[Creature]]s in {{BotW|-}}. The other eight are the [[Horse]], the Giant Horse, the Lord of the Mountain, the [[Mountain Buck]], the [[Mountain Doe]], the [[Stalhorse]], the [[Honeyvore Bear]], and the [[Grizzlemaw Bear]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:BotW White Horse Royal Horse Gear Model.png|The White Horse equipped with the Royal Horse Gear File:BotW Link and Zelda Horseback.png|Princess Zelda riding her White Horse File:BotW Ancient Horse Gear Concept Artwork.png|Concept artwork of the White Horse wearing the Ancient Horse Gear ==See Also== {{See Also| * Animal * Creature * Giant Horse * Horse * Royal Horse Gear * Storm }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Animals, Creatures, Horses |species= BotW, TotK }}
